title: Canonical normalized point module adjunction and scalar comparison
statement: For a scheme $Y$ and a commutative condensed ring $R$, use the actual point module inverse image $p_Y^*$ and direct image $p_{Y*,R}$ induced by the point geometric morphism [sk-def-sfb-pullback-from-point]. The datum $\mathrm{PointAdjunctionData}(R,Y)$ of [def-sfb-field-action-transport-data] fixes these functors, their additive and exact-inverse-image structures, and their adjunction by requiring its underlying abelian-sheaf unit and counit to equal the point geometric adjunction's unit and counit. This datum has a unique inhabitant; define the canonical point adjunction to be that unique datum. For every morphism $\varphi:R\to R'$ of commutative condensed rings, the datum $\mathrm{PointScalar}(\varphi,Y)$ of [def-sfb-field-action-geometric-transport-data], formed with these canonical point adjunctions, has a unique inhabitant: its restriction square is the exact localization of the ordinary mapMod/comap comparison, and its extension square is characterized by equality of all scalar-adjunction Hom transposes. Define the canonical point scalar comparison to be that unique datum. Its extension is the ordinary unbounded K-flat derived scalar/pullback comparison, preserving insertion of $1$; composing with the geometric counit gives the already defined pointProjection. No coefficient-map flatness or completeness is required.
